description.narrative: The development objective of the EnABLE is to enhance the inclusio n of beneficiary marginalized communities and their disadvantaged groups in Emission Reductions Programs under the CERF to maximize their carbon and non-carbon benefits. Achievement of this objective is expected to contribute to broader outcomescomma including improvement in the resilience of livelihoodscomma biodiversity conservationcomma and climate change mitigation.
